close_reason: Decision recorded in issue; no code change needed — these are preservation notes.
description: ocsp.rs verifies issuerNameHash and issuerKeyHash in the CertID before accepting a serial-number match. Without this check, a response issued for the same serial by a different CA (cross-CA replay attack) would pass. A future contributor who 'simplifies' the lookup to a serial-only match would reintroduce the vulnerability. The find-by-serial-then-verify-issuer-hashes order is intentional: find the candidate first, then reject it if the issuer doesn't match, keeping the algorithm straightforward.
title: CertID issuer hash verification is correct and must be preserved
